derivation_note: Reconstructed, not captured. All upstream-cited cases follow the upstream inline link test in voicefox/source/src/apple/api.rs:554-573 (recognises_links) and the link_target semantics at api.rs:442-479. The case-insensitive/trimmed rows are musid-dli extensions documented below.

cases.note: ?i= wins over the album id: it points at the song inside the album (upstream api.rs:447-450, inline test api.rs:559-562). musid-dli ignored ?i= before this batch and would have passed the whole '1440833097?i=1440833098' segment as the id
slug path: the id is the LAST path segment before ?/# (upstream api.rs:459-468). musid-dli took the FIRST segment ('ye-hui-mei') before this batch
upstream inline test (api.rs:568-570); playlist ids keep their case
musid-dli extension: id keeps original casing (upstream slices the original string, api.rs:459-469); only kind matching is case-insensitive
a bare numeric string is accepted as a song id (upstream api.rs:475-478)
musid-dli extension: trimmed + case-insensitive matching (to_ascii_lowercase preserves byte length so slices stay aligned)
an empty ?i= value is ignored (query_value requires a non-empty value, upstream api.rs:481-488)
fragment is cut (upstream api.rs:462 splits on ? and #)
trailing slash: empty trailing segments are skipped (rfind over non-empty segments)
upstream inline test: non-ASCII free text rejected (not all-digits, no kind segment)
kind segment present but no id after it → rejected (the id would be empty)
/artist/ is not a recognized kind (only song|album|playlist, upstream api.rs:451-455)

resolver_note: after recognition the resolver performs a live fetch per kind (song → fetch_song_detail → ResolvedLink::Track; album → container_tracks → ResolvedLink::Album; playlist → container_tracks → ResolvedLink::Playlist, musid-dli source_apple.rs LinkResolver::resolve_link). Those fetches are network-bound and covered by the apple smoke's link module, not by these offline vectors.
